description: The file defines a Controller class for managing customer-related actions in an OpenCart admin module. It includes methods for listing, editing, adding, enabling/disabling, deleting customers, as well as managing customer history, transactions, rewards, IP addresses, authorizations, and autocompletion.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer entities in OpenCart admin, including their details, statuses, histories, transactions, rewards, IPs, authorizations, and related CRUD operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point, sets up language, scripts, and view for customer list page.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs customer list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and renders the customer list with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares and displays the customer edit/add form, loading customer data and related info.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving customer data, including validation for various fields.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks a customer's login attempts.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected customers.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected customers.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected customers.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Allows admin to log in as a customer, redirecting accordingly.

methods.name: payment
methods.description: Displays payment/subscription info for a customer.

methods.name: getPayment
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve and prepare payment/subscription data for a customer.

methods.name: deletePayment
methods.description: Removes a customer's subscription/payment record.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays customer history records.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves customer history logs with pagination.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a new history comment to a customer.

methods.name: transaction
methods.description: Displays customer's transaction records.

methods.name: getTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of customer transactions.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Adds a transaction record for a customer.

methods.name: reward
methods.description: Displays customer reward points and history.

methods.name: getReward
methods.description: Internal method to fetch rewards data for a customer.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Adds reward points to a customer.

methods.name: ip
methods.description: Displays customer IP address logs.

methods.name: getIp
methods.description: Fetches IP address logs for a customer.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Displays authorization records for the customer.

methods.name: getAuthorize
methods.description: Retrieves authorizations for the customer.

methods.name: deleteAuthorize
methods.description: Deletes a customer authorization record.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides customer autocomplete suggestions based on name and email filters.

methods.name: customfield
methods.description: Fetches custom fields for customer groups.
